parts.headline: The Bubble Is in the Denominator

mentions.excerpt: Leyla Kunimoto, citing an Apollo presentation, reports that hyperscalers sold close to $250 billion of high-grade bonds in 2026, more than in the previous ten years combined.
Leyla Kunimoto of Accredited Insight traced the Jupiter money on October 5, 2026: about $18 billion of construction debt and $3 billion of Blue Owl equity.
